what_happened: This job involves listing a public AI video editing prompt and copying it onto really.bot for the directory. The prompt instructs an AI to act as a personal video editor, connecting a Google Drive account, and assembling a video edit based on user preferences. The AI reviews clips, adds transitions, sound balancing, titles, captions, and adjusts the aspect ratio as specified. The setup is saved for future use. This is a public pattern for video editing using AI.
